name: Tajuddin Ahmad
seoTitle: Tajuddin Ahmad - Mujibnagar Prime Minister and Liberation War Organizer
seoDescription: Profile of Tajuddin Ahmad, focusing on 1971 Liberation War connections, historical role, and related Bangladesh history.
shortAnswer: Tajuddin Ahmad is linked to the 1971 Liberation War in this timeline as Prime Minister of the Provisional Government.
role: Prime Minister of the Provisional Government
contribution: He coordinated wartime governance, diplomatic outreach, and strategic planning of the exile government, turning dispersed resistance into an organized state-led struggle.
context: Mujibnagar Government, 1971; linked to Indian and broader international diplomatic channels.
impact: He integrated political legitimacy, military coordination, and external support into a coherent wartime state framework.
highlight: He held the architecture of the war together when collapse was a real possibility.

faq.question: What was Tajuddin Ahmad's role in 1971?
faq.answer: After the March 1971 crackdown, he helped form and lead the Bangladesh government-in-exile at Mujibnagar and organized wartime governance during the Liberation War.
